Message.Name: Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: This message is used to notify TDDS customers if a trade report entered during the current business day, or up to the past three business days, has been canceled

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: This Security Symbol field indicates the security identifier assigned by FINRA for a given security

Field.Name: Original Message Sequence Number
Field.Description: The Original Message Sequence Number field indicates the message sequence number of the original outbound message for the transaction being reversed

Field.Name: Report Function
Field.Description: This Function field denotes if the original trade report is being cancelled or was reported in error

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message

Message.Name: General Administrative Message

Field.Name: Text

Message.Name: Closing Trade Summary Report Message
Message.Description: The closing trade summary will reflect the daily high, low, and closing prices as well as the total volume for the security

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: This Security Symbol field indicates the security identifier assigned by FINRA for a given security

Field.Name: Daily High Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Closing Price Denominator field indicates the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Closing Price field

Field.Name: Daily High Price
Field.Description: This Daily High Price field indicates the highest price at which the security traded during the session

Field.Name: Daily Low Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Closing Price Denominator field indicates the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Closing Price field

Field.Name: Daily Low Price
Field.Description: This Daily High Price field indicates the lowest price at which the security traded during the session

Field.Name: Closing Price Market Center
Field.Description: This field indicates the market center responsible for the closing price

Field.Name: Closing Price Denominator
Field.Description: The Closing Price Denominator field indicates the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Closing Price field

Field.Name: Closing Price
Field.Description: This Closing Price field reflects the final last sale eligible transaction reported to ORF for the security during the current business day

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: This field will be space filled

Field.Name: Net Change Denominator
Field.Description: The Net Change Denominator indicates the whole dollar and decimal digit composition of the Net Change Amount field

Field.Name: Net Change Amount
Field.Description: The Net Change Amount field reflects the absolute value of the difference between the current closing price and the adjusted previous day’s closing price

Field.Name: Net Change Direction
Field.Description: This field indicates the direction of net change field

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: This field indicates the currency in which the trade transaction was reported

Field.Name: Total Security Volume
Field.Description: This field reflects the total number of shares traded during the session for the given security

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: FINRA will disseminate this message to inform customers of trading actions, such as halts or trading resumptions which affect individual OTCBB or Other OTC securities

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: This Security Symbol field indicates the security identifier assigned by FINRA for a given security

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: used to relate the status of the individual security or marketplace

Field.Name: Trading Action Reason Code
Field.Description: The Reason Code indicates the reason for the current trading action status.

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Event Message
Message.Description: FINRA will disseminate this message to inform customers of an extraordinary market event trading action or a market wide circuit breaker event which will affect all security symbols for either OTCBB, Other OTC or both OTCBB and Other OTC market places

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: used to relate the status of the individual security or marketplace

Field.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Reason Code
Field.Description: The Reason Code indicates the reason for the current trading action status.

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of Day control message signifies the beginning of each operational cycle for TDDS processing

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of Day control message signals the end of active message dissemination for the TDDS operational cycle

Message.Name: Market Session Open Message
Message.Description: The Market Session Open Control Message signifies the opening of FINRA’s market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: Market Session Close Message
Message.Description: The Session Close Control Message signals the closing of FINRA’s market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: End Of Retransmission Requests Message
Message.Description: This message signals that no further retransmission requests will be honored. The End of Retransmission Requests message will be sent three times, at one-minute intervals

Message.Name: End Of Transmissions Message
Message.Description: The End of Transmissions Message signals that there will be no further transmissions of data sent through the TDDS line.

Message.Name: Line Integrity Message
Message.Description: The Line Integrity Control Message will be transmitted at approximately one-minute intervals to verify the operational integrity of the TDDS message transmission, and will be intermixed with other messages

Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: The Sequence Number Reset Message forces the resetting of the Sequence Number. The Sequence Number will either be reset to zero or to a number greater than the last number previously transmitted

Message.Name: End of Trade Reporting Message
Message.Description: The End of Trade Reporting Control Message signals that the ORF system is closed for market participant trade transactions
